text: Before any real customer traffic touches the new platform, Marcus Oyelaran and Ananya Reddy need proof it survives Haverbrook Tickets' worst moment: a hit show's on-sale.
A k6 load test models the real shape of that traffic -- a slow ramp, a sharp spike, and a long plateau -- against a staging cluster sized exactly like production.
They also deliberately break a slice of staging traffic on purpose, to prove the error-rate alert doesn't just light up a dashboard -- it actually pages someone.
Autoscaling adds pods cleanly, a routine deploy ships under load without dropping a single request, and the alert fires and pages in under five minutes.
Next: Celeste Marchbanks gives the go-call, and real customer traffic moves onto the new platform for the first time.
